## 3.3 Losses
3.3.1 As per Ministry of Power Orders referred in Article 3.2.3, there shall be no incidence of
ISTS losses applicable for entire term of this agreement.
3.3.2 The provisions of the Article 3.2.3 in regard to exemption/waiver of transmission charges
shall apply mutatis mutandis in regard to the transmission losses.
